sum_arr = [0] * 11

mod2 = 1000000007

ans = 0

def m1(x):
    return (x % mod1 + mod1) % mod1

def dfs1(x, v):
    global cnt
    if v > n:

    ve[x].append(m1(cnt - v))

def lower_bound(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr)
    while left < right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        if arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid
    return left

def dfs2(x, v):
    global cnt, ans
    if v > n:
        return
    if x >= 1:

            for i in range(7):

                ans = (ans + val * len(vec) + sum_arr[i] - mod1 * (len(vec) - pos)) % mod2

            return
        cnt += 1
        ans = (ans + m1(cnt - v)) % mod2
    start = 1 if x == 0 else 0
    for i in range(start, 10):
        dfs2(x + 1, v * 10 + i)
